title_en: Forming passive sentences 2: verb + -ing or to-infinitive
title_vi: Cấu tạo câu bị động (2): động từ + -ing hoặc to-V
theory_html:
A. Active verb + object + -ing → be + past participle + -ing

A. Chủ động động từ + tân ngữ + -ing → be + V3 + -ing

Verbs followed by object + -ing in the active are made passive with ‘be’ + past participle + -ing:

Động từ có tân ngữ + V-ing ở chủ động chuyển sang bị động bằng ‘be’ + V3 + V-ing:

  • They saw the monkey climbing over the fence. (= active) → The monkey was seen climbing over the fence. (= passive)

    Họ thấy con khỉ đang trèo qua hàng rào. → Con khỉ bị nhìn thấy đang trèo qua hàng rào.

Also: bring, catch, hear, find, keep, notice, observe, send, show

Tương tự: bring, catch, hear, find, keep, notice, observe, send, show

B. Verb + being + past participle

B. Động từ + being + V3

Some verbs that can be followed by an -ing form can be used with a passive form being + past participle:

Một số động từ đi với V-ing có thể dùng với dạng bị động being + V3:

  • I really love being given presents.

    Tôi rất thích được tặng quà.

  • The children enjoyed being taken to the zoo.

    Bọn trẻ thích thú khi được đưa đi sở thú.

Also: avoid, deny, describe, dislike, face, hate, (not) imagine, like, remember, report, resent

Tương tự: avoid, deny, describe, dislike, face, hate, (not) imagine, like, remember, report, resent

C. Noun phrase + -ing clause: usually no passive

C. Cụm danh từ + mệnh đề -ing: thường không có bị động

Verbs which in the active are followed by an object consisting of a noun phrase and -ing clause usually have no passive:

Động từ có tân ngữ gồm cụm danh từ và mệnh đề -ing ở chủ động thường không có dạng bị động:

  • I dread him (or his) finding out. (but not He is dreaded finding out)

    Tôi sợ anh ấy phát hiện ra.

Also: anticipate, appreciate, dislike, forget, hate, imagine, like, (not) mind, recall, remember

Tương tự: anticipate, appreciate, dislike, forget, hate, imagine, like, (not) mind, recall, remember

D. Verb + object + to-infinitive → be + past participle + to-infinitive

D. Động từ + tân ngữ + to-V → be + V3 + to-V

The active pattern verb + object + to-infinitive is made passive with ‘be’ + past participle + to-infinitive. Compare:

Mẫu chủ động động từ + tân ngữ + to-V chuyển sang bị động bằng ‘be’ + V3 + to-V. So sánh:

  • Mr Wang has taught Peter to sing for years. → Peter has been taught to sing (by Mr Wang) for years.

    Thầy Wang dạy Peter hát nhiều năm rồi. → Peter được dạy hát (bởi thầy Wang) nhiều năm rồi.

Also: advise, allow, ask, believe, consider, expect, feel, instruct, mean, order, require, tell, understand

Tương tự: advise, allow, ask, believe, consider, expect, feel, instruct, mean, order, require, tell, understand

Note that in some contexts it is possible to make both verbs passive:

Lưu ý: trong một số ngữ cảnh có thể chuyển cả hai động từ sang bị động:

  • Changes to the taxation system are expected to be proposed. (compare the active We expect the government to propose changes to the taxation system.)

    Những thay đổi trong hệ thống thuế được dự kiến sẽ được đề xuất.

Some verbs followed by an object + to-infinitive in the active have no passive:

Một số động từ có tân ngữ + to-V ở chủ động không có bị động:

  • Susan liked Karl to be there. (but not Karl was liked to be there.)

    Susan muốn Karl có mặt ở đó.

Also: (can’t) bear, hate, love, need, prefer, want, wish (= ‘liking’ and ‘wanting’ verbs)

Tương tự: (can’t) bear, hate, love, need, prefer, want, wish (= động từ ‘thích’ và ‘muốn’)

E. Verb + to-infinitive + object → verb + to be + past participle

E. Động từ + to-V + tân ngữ → động từ + to be + V3

The active pattern verb + to-infinitive + object is made passive with verb + to be + past participle. Compare:

Mẫu chủ động động từ + to-V + tân ngữ chuyển sang bị động bằng động từ + to be + V3. So sánh:

  • Supermarkets started to sell fresh pasta only in the 1990s. → Fresh pasta started to be sold by supermarkets only in the 1990s.

    Siêu thị mới bắt đầu bán mì Ý tươi từ những năm 1990. → Mì Ý tươi mới bắt đầu được bán ở siêu thị từ những năm 1990.

Also: (i) appear, begin, come, continue, seem, tend; (ii) agree, aim, arrange, attempt, hope, refuse, want

Tương tự: (i) appear, begin, come, continue, seem, tend; (ii) agree, aim, arrange, attempt, hope, refuse, want

The verbs in group (i) (and start) have corresponding meanings in active and passive sentences, but the verbs in group (ii) do not. Compare:

Các động từ nhóm (i) (và start) có nghĩa tương ứng ở câu chủ động và bị động, còn nhóm (ii) thì không. So sánh:

  • People have come to see organic food as something only the wealthy eat. (active) corresponds to Organic food has come to be seen as something only the wealthy eat. (passive)

    Người ta dần coi thực phẩm hữu cơ là thứ chỉ người giàu ăn. tương ứng với Thực phẩm hữu cơ dần bị coi là thứ chỉ người giàu ăn.

  • Petra wanted to help me. (active) does not correspond to I wanted to be helped by Petra. (passive)

    Petra muốn giúp tôi. không tương ứng với Tôi muốn được Petra giúp.

mcq.question: They saw the monkey climbing over the fence. → The monkey was seen ___ over the fence.
mcq.full: They saw the monkey climbing over the fence. → The monkey was seen climbing over the fence.
mcq.vi: Họ thấy con khỉ đang trèo qua hàng rào. → Con khỉ bị nhìn thấy đang trèo qua hàng rào.
mcq.expl:
see / hear / catch / find / keep / send + object + -ing → be seen / caught / found / kept … + -ing.
see / hear / catch / find / keep / send + tân ngữ + V-ing → be seen / caught / found / kept … + V-ing.
Điểm ngữ pháp: be seen + V-ing.
mcq.key: They saw the monkey climbing over the fence. → The monkey was seen ___ over the fence.|climbing

mcq.question: Inger was kept ___ for over three hours when she went for her dental appointment.
mcq.full: Inger was kept waiting for over three hours when she went for her dental appointment.
mcq.vi: Inger bị bắt chờ hơn ba tiếng khi đi khám răng.
mcq.expl:
see / hear / catch / find / keep / send + object + -ing → be seen / caught / found / kept … + -ing.
see / hear / catch / find / keep / send + tân ngữ + V-ing → be seen / caught / found / kept … + V-ing.
Điểm ngữ pháp: be kept + V-ing.
mcq.key: Inger was kept ___ for over three hours when she went for her dental appointment.|waiting

mcq.question: I was left ___ the baby while Karen went to answer the door.
mcq.full: I was left holding the baby while Karen went to answer the door.
mcq.vi: Tôi bị để lại bế em bé trong khi Karen ra mở cửa.
mcq.expl:
see / hear / catch / find / keep / send + object + -ing → be seen / caught / found / kept … + -ing.
see / hear / catch / find / keep / send + tân ngữ + V-ing → be seen / caught / found / kept … + V-ing.
Điểm ngữ pháp: be left + V-ing.
mcq.key: I was left ___ the baby while Karen went to answer the door.|holding

mcq.question: The man was observed ___ a suspicious package under a seat in the train.
mcq.full: The man was observed hiding a suspicious package under a seat in the train.
mcq.vi: Người đàn ông bị phát hiện giấu một gói hàng đáng ngờ dưới ghế trên tàu.
mcq.expl:
see / hear / catch / find / keep / send + object + -ing → be seen / caught / found / kept … + -ing.
see / hear / catch / find / keep / send + tân ngữ + V-ing → be seen / caught / found / kept … + V-ing.
Điểm ngữ pháp: be observed + V-ing.
mcq.key: The man was observed ___ a suspicious package under a seat in the train.|hiding

mcq.question: When the bike hit her, Ana was sent ___ to the ground.
mcq.full: When the bike hit her, Ana was sent tumbling to the ground.
mcq.vi: Khi bị xe đạp đâm, Ana bị hất ngã nhào xuống đất.
mcq.expl:
see / hear / catch / find / keep / send + object + -ing → be seen / caught / found / kept … + -ing.
see / hear / catch / find / keep / send + tân ngữ + V-ing → be seen / caught / found / kept … + V-ing.
Điểm ngữ pháp: be sent + V-ing.
mcq.key: When the bike hit her, Ana was sent ___ to the ground.|tumbling

mcq.question: The man was taken to hospital when he was found ___ lost and alone in the forest.
mcq.full: The man was taken to hospital when he was found wandering lost and alone in the forest.
mcq.vi: Người đàn ông được đưa vào viện khi được tìm thấy đang lang thang lạc lõng một mình trong rừng.
mcq.expl:
see / hear / catch / find / keep / send + object + -ing → be seen / caught / found / kept … + -ing.
see / hear / catch / find / keep / send + tân ngữ + V-ing → be seen / caught / found / kept … + V-ing.
Điểm ngữ pháp: be found + V-ing.
mcq.key: The man was taken to hospital when he was found ___ lost and alone in the forest.|wandering

mcq.question: They could hear Emil and Laura shouting at each other next door. → Emil and Laura could be heard ___ next door.
mcq.full: They could hear Emil and Laura shouting at each other next door. → Emil and Laura could be heard arguing next door.
mcq.vi: Họ nghe thấy Emil và Laura cãi nhau bên nhà hàng xóm. → Có thể nghe thấy Emil và Laura đang cãi nhau bên cạnh.
mcq.expl:
see / hear / catch / find / keep / send + object + -ing → be seen / caught / found / kept … + -ing.
see / hear / catch / find / keep / send + tân ngữ + V-ing → be seen / caught / found / kept … + V-ing.
Điểm ngữ pháp: be heard + V-ing.
mcq.key: They could hear Emil and Laura shouting at each other next door. → Emil and Laura could be heard ___ next door.|arguing

mcq.question: They saw the burglar getting into the museum through a window. → The burglar was observed ___ the museum through a window.
mcq.full: They saw the burglar getting into the museum through a window. → The burglar was observed entering the museum through a window.
mcq.vi: Họ thấy tên trộm vào bảo tàng qua cửa sổ. → Tên trộm bị phát hiện đang lẻn vào bảo tàng qua cửa sổ.
mcq.expl:
see / hear / catch / find / keep / send + object + -ing → be seen / caught / found / kept … + -ing.
see / hear / catch / find / keep / send + tân ngữ + V-ing → be seen / caught / found / kept … + V-ing.
Điểm ngữ pháp: be observed + V-ing.
mcq.key: They saw the burglar getting into the museum through a window. → The burglar was observed ___ the museum through a window.|entering

mcq.question: They caught Mrs Dee taking things from the shop. → Mrs Dee was caught ___.
mcq.full: They caught Mrs Dee taking things from the shop. → Mrs Dee was caught shoplifting.
mcq.vi: Họ bắt quả tang bà Dee lấy đồ trong cửa hàng. → Bà Dee bị bắt quả tang ăn cắp.
mcq.expl:
see / hear / catch / find / keep / send + object + -ing → be seen / caught / found / kept … + -ing.
see / hear / catch / find / keep / send + tân ngữ + V-ing → be seen / caught / found / kept … + V-ing.
Điểm ngữ pháp: be caught + V-ing.
mcq.key: They caught Mrs Dee taking things from the shop. → Mrs Dee was caught ___.|shoplifting

mcq.question: I really love being ___ presents.
mcq.full: I really love being given presents.
mcq.vi: Tôi rất thích được tặng quà.
mcq.expl:
avoid / deny / enjoy / hate / love / remember / resent / face + being + past participle.
avoid / deny / enjoy / hate / love / remember / resent / face + being + V3.
Điểm ngữ pháp: love + being + V3.
mcq.key: I really love being ___ presents.|given

mcq.question: The children enjoyed being ___ to the zoo.
mcq.full: The children enjoyed being taken to the zoo.
mcq.vi: Bọn trẻ thích thú khi được đưa đi sở thú.
mcq.expl:
avoid / deny / enjoy / hate / love / remember / resent / face + being + past participle.
avoid / deny / enjoy / hate / love / remember / resent / face + being + V3.
Điểm ngữ pháp: enjoy + being + V3.
mcq.key: The children enjoyed being ___ to the zoo.|taken

mcq.question: When the police first questioned him, Wayne denied ___ involved in the robbery.
mcq.full: When the police first questioned him, Wayne denied being involved in the robbery.
mcq.vi: Khi cảnh sát thẩm vấn lần đầu, Wayne phủ nhận có dính líu đến vụ cướp.
mcq.expl:
avoid / deny / enjoy / hate / love / remember / resent / face + being + past participle.
avoid / deny / enjoy / hate / love / remember / resent / face + being + V3.
Điểm ngữ pháp: deny + being + V3.
mcq.key: When the police first questioned him, Wayne denied ___ involved in the robbery.|being

mcq.question: When I woke up in hospital, I remembered ___ bitten by the snake but nothing after that.
mcq.full: When I woke up in hospital, I remembered being bitten by the snake but nothing after that.
mcq.vi: Khi tỉnh dậy trong bệnh viện, tôi nhớ bị rắn cắn nhưng sau đó thì không nhớ gì.
mcq.expl:
avoid / deny / enjoy / hate / love / remember / resent / face + being + past participle.
avoid / deny / enjoy / hate / love / remember / resent / face + being + V3.
Điểm ngữ pháp: remember + being + V3.
mcq.key: When I woke up in hospital, I remembered ___ bitten by the snake but nothing after that.|being

mcq.question: They avoided ___ taken prisoner by pretending to be dead.
mcq.full: They avoided being taken prisoner by pretending to be dead.
mcq.vi: Họ tránh bị bắt làm tù binh bằng cách giả chết.
mcq.expl:
avoid / deny / enjoy / hate / love / remember / resent / face + being + past participle.
avoid / deny / enjoy / hate / love / remember / resent / face + being + V3.
Điểm ngữ pháp: avoid + being + V3.
mcq.key: They avoided ___ taken prisoner by pretending to be dead.|being

mcq.question: Two teenagers yesterday faced ___ expelled from school after they were found with over a hundred stolen mobile phones.
mcq.full: Two teenagers yesterday faced being expelled from school after they were found with over a hundred stolen mobile phones.
mcq.vi: Hôm qua hai thiếu niên đối mặt với việc bị đuổi học sau khi bị phát hiện có hơn trăm điện thoại ăn cắp.
mcq.expl:
avoid / deny / enjoy / hate / love / remember / resent / face + being + past participle.
avoid / deny / enjoy / hate / love / remember / resent / face + being + V3.
Điểm ngữ pháp: face + being + V3.
mcq.key: Two teenagers yesterday faced ___ expelled from school after they were found with over a hundred stolen mobile phones.|being

mcq.question: Tarik had worked in the company for 30 years and he rather resented ___ orders by people who had been there only weeks.
mcq.full: Tarik had worked in the company for 30 years and he rather resented being given orders by people who had been there only weeks.
mcq.vi: Tarik làm ở công ty 30 năm và khá bực khi bị ra lệnh bởi những người mới vào vài tuần.
mcq.expl:
avoid / deny / enjoy / hate / love / remember / resent / face + being + past participle.
avoid / deny / enjoy / hate / love / remember / resent / face + being + V3.
Điểm ngữ pháp: resent + being + V3.
mcq.key: Tarik had worked in the company for 30 years and he rather resented ___ orders by people who had been there only weeks.|being given

mcq.question: The other children made Ollie unhappy when they teased him. → Ollie hated ___ by the other children.
mcq.full: The other children made Ollie unhappy when they teased him. → Ollie hated being teased by the other children.
mcq.vi: Bọn trẻ khác làm Ollie buồn khi trêu cậu. → Ollie ghét bị trêu chọc bởi bọn trẻ khác.
mcq.expl:
avoid / deny / enjoy / hate / love / remember / resent / face + being + past participle.
avoid / deny / enjoy / hate / love / remember / resent / face + being + V3.
Điểm ngữ pháp: hate + being + V3.
mcq.key: The other children made Ollie unhappy when they teased him. → Ollie hated ___ by the other children.|being teased

mcq.question: They criticised her but she wasn’t unhappy about it. → She didn’t mind ___.
mcq.full: They criticised her but she wasn’t unhappy about it. → She didn’t mind being criticised.
mcq.vi: Họ chỉ trích cô ấy nhưng cô không buồn. → Cô ấy không ngại bị chỉ trích.
mcq.expl:
avoid / deny / enjoy / hate / love / remember / resent / face + being + past participle.
avoid / deny / enjoy / hate / love / remember / resent / face + being + V3.
Điểm ngữ pháp: mind + being + V3.
mcq.key: They criticised her but she wasn’t unhappy about it. → She didn’t mind ___.|being criticised

mcq.question: I dread him ___ out.
mcq.full: I dread him finding out.
mcq.vi: Tôi sợ anh ấy phát hiện ra.
mcq.expl:
dread / appreciate / mind / remember + noun phrase + -ing → usually no passive.
dread / appreciate / mind / remember + cụm danh từ + V-ing → thường không có bị động.
Điểm ngữ pháp: dread + O + V-ing (không có bị động).
mcq.key: I dread him ___ out.|finding

mcq.question: Mr Wang has taught Peter to sing for years. → Peter has been taught ___ (by Mr Wang) for years.
mcq.full: Mr Wang has taught Peter to sing for years. → Peter has been taught to sing (by Mr Wang) for years.
mcq.vi: Thầy Wang dạy Peter hát nhiều năm rồi. → Peter được dạy hát nhiều năm rồi.
mcq.expl:
advise / ask / expect / require / tell + object + to-infinitive → be + past participle + to-infinitive; like / want / prefer + object + to-infinitive → no passive.
advise / ask / expect / require / tell + tân ngữ + to-V → be + V3 + to-V; like / want / prefer + tân ngữ + to-V → không có bị động.
Điểm ngữ pháp: be taught + to-V.
mcq.key: Mr Wang has taught Peter to sing for years. → Peter has been taught ___ (by Mr Wang) for years.|to sing

mcq.question: Changes to the taxation system are expected ___.
mcq.full: Changes to the taxation system are expected to be proposed.
mcq.vi: Những thay đổi trong hệ thống thuế được dự kiến sẽ được đề xuất.
mcq.expl:
advise / ask / expect / require / tell + object + to-infinitive → be + past participle + to-infinitive; like / want / prefer + object + to-infinitive → no passive.
advise / ask / expect / require / tell + tân ngữ + to-V → be + V3 + to-V; like / want / prefer + tân ngữ + to-V → không có bị động.
Điểm ngữ pháp: Cả hai động từ ở bị động.
mcq.key: Changes to the taxation system are expected ___.|to be proposed

mcq.question: They wanted us to show our passports at the border. → We were asked ___ our passports at the border.
mcq.full: They wanted us to show our passports at the border. → We were asked to show our passports at the border.
mcq.vi: Họ yêu cầu chúng tôi xuất trình hộ chiếu ở biên giới. → Chúng tôi được yêu cầu xuất trình hộ chiếu ở biên giới.
mcq.expl:
advise / ask / expect / require / tell + object + to-infinitive → be + past participle + to-infinitive; like / want / prefer + object + to-infinitive → no passive.
advise / ask / expect / require / tell + tân ngữ + to-V → be + V3 + to-V; like / want / prefer + tân ngữ + to-V → không có bị động.
Điểm ngữ pháp: be asked + to-V.
mcq.key: They wanted us to show our passports at the border. → We were asked ___ our passports at the border.|to show

mcq.question: They think that over 20,000 people will go to the pop concert. → The pop concert is expected ___ over 20,000 people.
mcq.full: They think that over 20,000 people will go to the pop concert. → The pop concert is expected to attract over 20,000 people.
mcq.vi: Họ nghĩ hơn 20.000 người sẽ đến buổi hòa nhạc pop. → Buổi hòa nhạc pop được dự kiến thu hút hơn 20.000 người.
mcq.expl:
advise / ask / expect / require / tell + object + to-infinitive → be + past participle + to-infinitive; like / want / prefer + object + to-infinitive → no passive.
advise / ask / expect / require / tell + tân ngữ + to-V → be + V3 + to-V; like / want / prefer + tân ngữ + to-V → không có bị động.
Điểm ngữ pháp: be expected + to-V.
mcq.key: They think that over 20,000 people will go to the pop concert. → The pop concert is expected ___ over 20,000 people.|to attract

mcq.question: They said I had to fill in two copies of the customs declaration. → I was required ___ two copies of the customs declaration.
mcq.full: They said I had to fill in two copies of the customs declaration. → I was required to complete two copies of the customs declaration.
mcq.vi: Họ bảo tôi phải điền hai bản tờ khai hải quan. → Tôi được yêu cầu điền hai bản tờ khai hải quan.
mcq.expl:
advise / ask / expect / require / tell + object + to-infinitive → be + past participle + to-infinitive; like / want / prefer + object + to-infinitive → no passive.
advise / ask / expect / require / tell + tân ngữ + to-V → be + V3 + to-V; like / want / prefer + tân ngữ + to-V → không có bị động.
Điểm ngữ pháp: be required + to-V.
mcq.key: They said I had to fill in two copies of the customs declaration. → I was required ___ two copies of the customs declaration.|to complete

mcq.question: Susan liked Karl to be there. → Passive: ___
mcq.b: Karl was liked to be there.
mcq.full: Susan liked Karl to be there. → Passive: no passive is possible
mcq.vi: Susan muốn Karl có mặt ở đó. → Bị động: không có dạng bị động
mcq.expl:
advise / ask / expect / require / tell + object + to-infinitive → be + past participle + to-infinitive; like / want / prefer + object + to-infinitive → no passive.
advise / ask / expect / require / tell + tân ngữ + to-V → be + V3 + to-V; like / want / prefer + tân ngữ + to-V → không có bị động.
Điểm ngữ pháp: like + O + to-V không có bị động.
mcq.key: Susan liked Karl to be there. → Passive: ___|no passive is possible

mcq.question: Supermarkets started to sell fresh pasta only in the 1990s. → Fresh pasta started ___ by supermarkets only in the 1990s.
mcq.full: Supermarkets started to sell fresh pasta only in the 1990s. → Fresh pasta started to be sold by supermarkets only in the 1990s.
mcq.vi: Siêu thị mới bắt đầu bán mì Ý tươi từ những năm 1990. → Mì Ý tươi mới bắt đầu được bán ở siêu thị từ những năm 1990.
